# Goal and offer: Tidewater Plumbing

## One goal

Conversion action (the one thing a visitor should do): book a same-day plumber visit online (provided by owner, 2026-09-28)

Why this action and not another: 71 percent of booked jobs last quarter started with a phone call or online booking, and online bookings arrive with photos of the problem, which lets the dispatcher send the right parts (provided by owner, 2026-09-28).

What happens right after the click: a booking form with four fields, then a text message within 15 minutes confirming the arrival window (provided by owner, 2026-09-28).

## Dream outcome

Water stops leaking today, the fix holds, and the bill matches the price agreed before any work started.

Emotional payoff: relief that the problem is handled and no surprise invoice is coming.

Time to first result (only if true and provable): a plumber on site the same day for bookings made before 2 pm, Monday to Saturday (provided by owner, 2026-09-28).

## The offer

Name: Same-day repair visit

Price and terms: 89 USD call-out fee, credited against the repair if the customer goes ahead; fixed price quoted on site before work starts (provided by owner, 2026-09-28).

What is included: diagnosis, written fixed-price quote, repair with standard parts carried in the van, cleanup, 12-month labor warranty.

Risk reversal (only if it really exists): 12-month labor warranty on every repair, confirmed in the owner's terms of service (provided by owner, 2026-09-28).

Target: 5 percent within 60 days of launch

How it is measured: analytics event booking_submitted on the confirmation page
